name: TotalSegmentator v2 (University Hospital Basel), cardiac-protocol subset
tier: T2 (cardiac-protocol contrast CT, but resampled to 1.5 mm isotropic); 14 more 'ct angiography thorax' are T3

n_scans.unit: cardiac CT volumes: 46 'ct heart-thorakale aorta', 34 'ct aortic valve' (TAVI planning), 34 'ct heart', 13 'ct left artrium'. Not counted: 3 'ct coronary arteries' (s0085 checked: non-contrast calcium scan, 135x135x95). Plus 14 'ct angiography thorax' (T3)

format: NIfTI (.nii.gz), one folder per case sXXXX/ct.nii.gz plus segmentations/*.nii.gz, inside one 23.6 GB zip
labels: 117-class TotalSegmentator labels per case (heart chambers, aorta, pulmonary artery and more; no coronaries)
steps_to_access: Zip URL: https://zenodo.org/api/records/10047292/files/Totalsegmentator_dataset_v201.zip/content . You do not need the whole 23.6 GB: the server supports HTTP Range, so read the zip central directory and pull single members (I extracted meta.csv and 6 ct.nii.gz files this way, 2-22 MB each). To enumerate, read meta.csv (columns image_id;study_type;split;manufacturer;scanner_model;kvp...) and filter study_type in {'ct heart-thorakale aorta','ct aortic valve','ct heart','ct left artrium'}. Member path pattern: sXXXX/ct.nii.gz.
provenance/duplicates: Same data as TotalSegmentator v1 (Zenodo 6802614) plus extra cases. TAVRP-PL (Zenodo 16274177, listed in round 1 as T3) is a 578-case subset with pseudo-labels. Round 1 listed this source only as T3 with 'few gated cardiac scans'. The meta.csv count of 127 cardiac-protocol scans is new.
verified: Yes. meta.csv downloaded and counted. Sampled cases: s0738 'ct heart' blood pool about 470-525 HU; s0270 'ct heart' about 325 HU; s0671 'ct left artrium' median about 334 HU (150-1000 HU window); s0189 'ct aortic valve' (thorax-to-pelvis TAVI scan) median about 238 HU; s0230 'heart-thorakale aorta' median about 234 HU. All 1.5x1.5x1.5 mm. Some files have non-orthonormal direction cosines and SimpleITK refuses them; nibabel reads them.
notes: All volumes were resampled by the dataset authors to 1.5 mm isotropic, so coronaries show only as coarse proximal segments. Good as bulk contrast cardiac CT at low resolution, not as coronary-detail CCTA. Note the ITK direction-cosine issue for the ingest code. Case IDs (first few): heart-thorakale aorta s0230,s0184,s0138,s0032...; aortic valve s0189,s0049,s0111,s0095...; heart s0270,s0738,s0710,s0684...; left atrium s0671,s0594,s1280,s1258...

name: Epicardial fat segmentation in non-contrast and post-contrast cardiac CT (Siriapisith, Kusakunniran, Haddawy; Mahidol / Siriraj, Thailand)
tier: T2 (post-contrast cardiac CT; ECG gating not verified, so possibly T1)

n_scans.unit: post-contrast (CE) cardiac CT volumes (20 train + 20 test); the same zip also holds about 56 non-contrast volumes (not counted)

format: NRRD (gzip, int32 HU), 512x512x~64, 0.40x0.40x2.5 mm, heart-centred FOV about 204 mm
steps_to_access: Single zip: https://ndownloader.figshare.com/files/31584917 (dataset.zip, 4.95 GB; it redirects to S3 and supports Range GETs, so single members can be pulled). Enumerate with the figshare API https://api.figshare.com/v2/articles/17039813 and the zip directory (528 entries). Contrast paths: dataset/Epicardial_train_CE/CE001..CE020_CE.nrrd and dataset/Epicardial_test_CE/CE021..CE040_CE.nrrd.
provenance/duplicates: Thai hospital cohort (PeerJ Comput Sci 2021). Not related to ImageCAS or any round-1 source.
verified: Yes. Downloaded CE001_CE.nrrd (18.5 MB): HU-calibrated (min -3024), central blood-pool mode 450-475 HU, median 420 HU. Contrast confirmed. Deleted.
notes: Slices are 2.5 mm thick, so coronaries are visible but coarse. 64 slices (16 cm) cover the whole heart. It is unclear whether the CE and NC series come from the same patients.

name: Figshare 23057000 'Test Data.rar': two CCTA volumes (Pengling Ren)
tier: T1 (CCTA by description; resolution and blood-pool HU consistent with CCTA)
format: RAR containing NIfTI int16 (512x512x256, 0.416/0.430 mm in-plane, 0.625 mm slices)
steps_to_access: https://ndownloader.figshare.com/files/40794539 (the second file 40795820 has the same name and size and an identical first 1 MB, so it is a duplicate upload). Extract with bsdtar -xf.
provenance/duplicates: Uploader Pengling Ren, no paper linked; probably a Chinese hospital (unverified). Not ImageCAS by geometry: ImageCAS slice spacing is 0.25-0.45 mm, these are 0.625 mm with exactly 256 slices.
verified: Yes. Downloaded and extracted. PA0 blood pool about 450 HU (median 450), PA1 about 425-450 HU (median 389). Deleted.
notes: Tiny, but true high-resolution CCTA. The NIfTI descrip field holds 'Time=...' (dcm2niix-style); there are no other identifiers.

name: CT mesh datasets for patient-specific atrial fibre mapping (Sinitsyna et al., Zenodo 21855641)
tier: T1/T2 (high-resolution cardiac CTA; gating not stated)

n_scans.unit: CT volume (Zvag/CT_Volume.nrrd). The other 5 patients (Ale, Bas, Ero, Ost/Kar, Test) ship only seg.nrrd label maps and meshes, no CT

labels: LA segmentation (Segmentation_Zvag.seg.nrrd), LA meshes, fibre fields
steps_to_access: https://zenodo.org/api/records/21855641/files/Zvag.zip/content (452 MB zip; range-extract the member Zvag/CT_Volume.nrrd, 85 MB). File list: https://zenodo.org/api/records/21855641
provenance/duplicates: Russian-language README (manuscript under review at JoVE); hospital not named. Not a known duplicate.
verified: Yes. Extracted CT_Volume.nrrd: HU-calibrated, blood-pool mode 450-475 HU (median 424). Deleted.
notes: One scan only. Zenodo threw SSL EOF errors under repeated range requests, so retry with backoff.

name: STOPSTORM Contouring Benchmark (EU Horizon STOPSTORM.eu, Zenodo 22127731)
tier: T2 (contrast cardiac CT, but deformably registered and resampled onto the planning-CT grid)

n_scans.unit: deformed contrast cardiac CT series (plus 3 matching radiotherapy planning CTs and 1 deformed cardiac MR)

labels: Contouring guidelines for heart substructures including coronaries (reference contours not checked in detail)
provenance/duplicates: VT radioablation patients from STOPSTORM consortium centres. New.
verified: Yes. Downloaded the 170 MB zip and read all 3 deformed cardiac CT series. Blood-pool mode: Case1 325 HU (median 301), Case2 200 HU (median 263), Case3 150 HU (median 207). Deleted.
notes: Low value: resampling to 1-1.5 mm in-plane and 2 mm slices blurs the coronaries. The planning CTs are mostly non-contrast.

name: Contrast / non-contrast cardiac CT of pigs (Nordbø et al., Figshare+ 30398977, Norway)
tier: T2-animal (porcine contrast cardiac CT, multi-phase); human-only projects may exclude it

n_scans.unit: pig-scan sessions (10 pigs x 6 longitudinal rounds), each with a contrast multi-phase series (IM00001..IM000NN, about 100-120 MB per phase), plus non-contrast series and position variants

format: NIfTI (.nii.gz) per phase inside six 22-35 GB tar files (AHFP-Round-1..6.tar); whole-heart and LV masks
labels: Whole heart and LV masks (some phases)
steps_to_access: Tars: https://ndownloader.figshare.com/files/{66226196 (Round-1), 59113601 (R2), 59117399 (R3), 66229397 (R4), 59124065 (R5), 59132822 (R6)}. Tar has no index, so stream it: in Round-1 the first contrast phase (Control_1_7569/Heart_with_contrast_back/IM00001_ct.nii.gz) starts at about 1.2 GB. Enumerate via https://api.figshare.com/v2/articles/30398977 and a streaming tar listing.
provenance/duplicates: Norwegian pig cohort (Canon Alphenix 4D CT and Aquilion One Genesis). New, not human.
verified: Yes. Streamed Round-1 to the first contrast file (117 MB) and saved only that. 560x512x512, spacing 0.25x0.614x0.614 (axes look permuted), values -3897..21945 (not cleanly HU-bounded), median 386 HU in the 150-1000 HU window, so contrast is visible. Deleted.
notes: Animal data and a 154 GB download. Phases are 4D (several per contrast series). Only worth it if porcine coronaries are acceptable.
